argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\WebAIBridge-R70-GPT-PLANNER-20261014-GPT6'
$plan=Join-Path $root 'app\data\r70-qa-verified-wave-plan.json'
$state=Join-Path $root 'app\data\r70-qa-verified-wave-state.json'
if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $plan)){throw 'PLAN_NOT_STAGED'}
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $state){throw 'STATE_EXISTS_REFUSE_REPLAY'}
$line=& node.exe (Join-Path $root 'app\r70-stage-gpt-planner.js') --observe-once $plan $state 2>&1
$rc=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('READONLY_PROCESS_EXIT='+$rc)
if($rc -eq 0){$j=($line|Out-String|ConvertFrom-Json);Write-Output ('COORDINATOR_STATUS='+$j.status);Write-Output ('BRIDGE_HEALTH='+$j.bridgeHealth);Write-Output ('TASK_COUNT='+$j.taskCount);Write-Output ('RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED='+$j.reconciliationRequired)}
Write-Output ('COORDINATOR_STATE_WRITTEN='+(Test-Path -LiteralPath $state))
Write-Output ('REAL_ASSIGNMENT_COUNT='+@((Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments' -TimeoutSec 3).assignments).Count)
Write-Output ('PRODUCTION_HEAD='+(& git.exe -C 'E:\WebAIBridge' rev-parse HEAD))
if($rc -ne 0){throw 'R70_READONLY_OBSERVATION_FAILED'}
data.stdout:
READONLY_PROCESS_EXIT=0
COORDINATOR_STATUS=READ_ONLY
BRIDGE_HEALTH=DEGRADED
TASK_COUNT=
RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED=0
COORDINATOR_STATE_WRITTEN=True
REAL_ASSIGNMENT_COUNT=71
PRODUCTION_HEAD=66e2ca7681b5e4c4affde9641b69e5582b718f99
